svg.title: The Dapr control plane across a cluster of machines
svg.desc: Three dashed regions stand for three machines, VM1, VM2 and VM3. Each runs the same four services in a column, and arrows join each service across all three machines, which is what makes the control plane highly available. Described once beside their row, the four are Consul for DNS name resolution if you choose it over multicast DNS, the Dapr placement service which creates the mapping table of actor instances, the Dapr scheduler which schedules jobs at specified intervals for the Jobs and Workflow APIs and for actor reminders, and Dapr sentry which assigns SPIFFE identity and manages mTLS. An application with a Dapr sidecar runs on the first machine and another on the third, and the two sidecars call each other. On the right, the sidecars use components for publish and subscribe, workflows, state management, configuration and secrets, and below those is the certificate store shared by all the machines.
